title: Legal Accountability / Human Consequence Case Seeds
purpose: Normalized graph seeds for court cases, testimony, settlements, family actions, lawyers/intermediaries, platform-harm evidence and accountability mechanisms. These records are not a guilt list.

status_rules.pleading_survived: Court allowed a claim to proceed past an early motion; facts remain unproven unless separately established.
status_rules.settled: Parties resolved claims; do not infer admission unless explicit.
status_rules.adjudicated_civil: Civil liability or factual ruling established within the stated scope.
status_rules.adjudicated_criminal: Criminal conviction or guilty plea within the stated scope.
status_rules.official_finding: Coroner, inspector general, grand jury or official inquiry finding within its authority.
